title: Chapter 6784: Call The Baldy Here

Chapter 6784: Call The Baldy Here

Chapter 6784: Call The Baldy Here

“Don’t be like that, you were one of the greatest geniuses in the nine worlds but here, you’re just another cultivator. What’s there to be proud about?” Li Qiye couldn’t help but laugh.

“I’m not proud because of my talent.” The youth said.

“What you can’t accept is having a crow perched over your head. You tell yourself that if you were blessed with immortality, you would have had the same achievements.” Li Qiye said.

“Close enough, wouldn’t have been difficult in your position.” The youth said.

“Do you still have this belief now?” Li Qiye smirked.

The youth sighed and lowered his head: “No, plenty of geniuses here, some with endless lifespan.”

“See, you’ve changed completely.” Li Qiye tapped his shoulder and said: “Look at you now, just an ordinary fellow, something you used to despise.”

“All beings are ordinary. I simply seek wisdom and self-reflection, there’s no need to care about outward appearance.” The youth responded.

“No problem at all. Returning to simplicity, as plain as an uncut stone, nothing wrong with it at all.” Li Qiye clapped his hands and laughed.

The youth, who was somewhat defiant, turned red.

“Being able to start over is a good thing.” Li Qiye said: “You still have a long way to go, and your path is not about how far you can go but how far Lil’ Black can go. Otherwise, your knowledge and wisdom will be for nothing, you will just be a speck of dust in Heavenrealm. You must be aware of this.”

“I understand, I will follow on this path.” He took a deep breath and admitted defeat.

“Where is Lil’ Black?” Li Qiye asked.

“In isolated cultivation, there’s some concern about the bloodline.” He said.

“The sea of wisdom didn’t cleanse it?” Li Qiye’s eyes narrowed.

“We were in a hurry.” The youth said.

Li Qiye took out the crystal bottle with a mysterious drop of blood and said: “Give this to him, it should help him find the way.”

“This is...” The youth was surprised to see the blood inside.

“I’m afraid you two didn’t search the sea either.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes.” The youth bowed deeply, putting his pride aside. He would never have done so in the past.

“Call the baldy over.” Li Qiye waved.

“I don’t know where he is, I’m just here to handle some minor affairs for him. No one knows his location, it’s just unpredictable drifting.” He said.

“You don’t expect me to drag him here myself, do you?” Li Qiye frowned.

“That’s none of my business.” The youth stopped aside, looking completely uninvolved like a spectator waiting to watch a good show with a hint of schadenfreude.

“I’m here, I’m here.” Another youth with a cheerful voice hurried over. His head was perfectly round and smooth, so shiny it almost hurt the eyes. His smile radiated warmth and friendliness.

“Sigh, Brother, couldn’t you at least block the old man a little bit for me? Aren’t you supposed to be peerless in wisdom and intelligence?” The baldy complained.

“How can I stop him?” The youth threw up his hands and stood aside.

“Old man, are you that bored? I see, you probably noticed how hard my life is, wandering through dark lands and sleeping in the wilderness. I’m practically as skinny as a starving horse now, how about giving me some money so I can enjoy life a bit...” The baldy said.

“Not every deal can be done, not this one.” Li Qiye frowned and exerted his supreme will.

There existed a black mountain capable of eradicating immortals in Duality Enterprise. When Li Qiye’s supreme will descended, the mountain felt threatened and wanted to use a power capable of shaking Heavenrealm.

“Boom!” Alas, the will extinguished this power and reduced it to a regular mountain. It fell and crashed into the ground, shattering.

“Hey! Hey! Old man, what are you doing?! How am I going to compensate them?!” The baldy jumped in anger.

“Compensate? I’ll wipe them out.” Li Qiye said.

“Damn it, I’m a merchant, not a robber and killer.” The baldy said.

“I am.” Li Qiye said.

“Fine, fine, being entangled with you is the worst luck.” His smile was nowhere to be seen.

“You overestimate yourself, I’ll throw you back and let you get a taste of what worst luck truly is.” Li Qiye said.

“Hey, don’t be so unreasonable.” The baldy knew Li Qiye was not messing around.

“An unpolished jade cannot be made into a vase.” Li Qiye said: “Your dao heart is alright, but you have a long way to go before catching up with me.”

“Don’t go polishing me now, I just want to be a mischievous jade.” The baldy surrendered.

“You do have the right to choose.” Li Qiye smiled again.

“This easy?” The baldy thought Li Qiye compromised too quickly.

“Just like that?” The general manager seemed disappointed as well.

“Sigh, Brother, I know you’re not satisfied, you spent your life wanting to take the old man down. Do it, now your chance, I’ll cheer you on!” The baldy laughed.

“Couldn’t beat him back then, definitely not now.” The youth said dejectedly.

“Right, you can’t even take me down because of my dao heart, let alone him. Forget it, ignore him, he’s just a passerby, not one of us. He won’t be here for much longer, he’ll either leave or the villainous heaven will take care of him. Why fuss over an old man whose time is limited?” The baldy said.

The youth didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. He stared at Li Qiye and shook his head: “He’s not wrong.”

The baldy heard this and exclaimed: “No way, are you really going to take down the heaven?”

“What do you think?” Li Qiye said.

“How do I know, I’m not a worm living in your stomach.” The baldy replied irritably and glanced at the youth: “He understands you more than I do.”

“I should be the one asking questions. What have you been doing here?” Li Qiye said.
